record.title: Unauthenticated anyone can read, write, impersonate agents in, and reset the shared group-chat thread
record.description: GROUPCHAT_TOKEN is unset on the live qwenpaw-groupchat Worker, so checkToken() returns true for every request and all thread endpoints (GET /thread, POST /thread/start, POST /thread/message, POST /thread/reset) are open to anyone who knows the URL. An unauthenticated caller can read the full thread, post as a user or as either agent (subject only to turn-taking), start new rounds, and wipe the thread with {confirm:true}. No QwenPaw account takeover or code execution: the relay is not installed, so fake agent turns do not reach QwenPaw.

trace.what: checkToken(): if (!this.env.GROUPCHAT_TOKEN) return true — no token configured means every request passes auth
GET / reports auth_required: Boolean(this.env.GROUPCHAT_TOKEN), i.e. false when the secret is unset
GET /thread gated only by checkToken(); with token unset the 401 branch is unreachable
POST /thread/start gated only by checkToken(); same bypass
POST /thread/message gated only by checkToken(); agent-role posts are checked only for turn order and participant name, not identity
POST /thread/reset gated only by checkToken(); {confirm:true} then wipes the thread

evidence.output: {"service":"qwenpaw-groupchat","thread":"one shared thread for QwenPaw agents default + QwenPaw_QA_Agent_0.2","store":"durable-object (sqlite)","auth_required":false,...}

record.conditions: Verified read-only only: verifier performed no POST, start, message, or reset (thread observed clean/reset, seq 0, messages []). Write/impersonation/reset success rests on the source trace above plus the hunter's live POST evidence, which the verifier did not re-run to avoid re-polluting the reset thread. Relay-not-installed (so fake turns do not reach QwenPaw) is as stated in the candidate and was not independently re-verified.
record.remediation: Set the token with `wrangler secret put GROUPCHAT_TOKEN` on the qwenpaw-groupchat Worker, then verify GET / reports auth_required:true and unauthenticated/wrong-token GET /thread and POST /thread/message return 401. Side effect: the owner and the relay (when installed) must send X-Groupchat-Token on every thread request; setting the secret is a user/parent action via wrangler or the Cloudflare API.

local: Re-read checkToken and the 401 gates at lines 177, 185, 200, 254 after any change; confirm no endpoint bypasses checkToken.
deployment: GET / shows auth_required:true; GET /thread with no token and with a wrong token returns 401; POST /thread/message with the correct token still succeeds; POST /thread/reset with a wrong token returns 401.
